description: In Utero album-route candidates for evidence capture, not a generic Nirvana playlist.
candidate_policy: Prefer album sequence and per-track functions. Do not use non-album Nirvana items unless the mission explicitly explains why.

candidates.title: In Utero
candidates.candidate_reason: Album object for Memory Route framing and full-record hypothesis.

music_kit_search_hint.preferred_version_notes: Use canonical studio album; note 2013 mix separately if chosen.
music_kit_search_hint.avoid_versions: Avoid tribute, live, and deluxe-only sequencing unless deliberate.

candidates.notes_warnings: Album route should capture track-specific evidence.

candidates.title: Serve the Servants
candidates.candidate_reason: Opening thesis: anti-myth, bite, and Albini body.

candidates.title: Scentless Apprentice
candidates.candidate_reason: Tests body force and abrasive negative space beyond singalong hooks.

candidates.title: Heart-Shaped Box
candidates.candidate_reason: Single architecture under rot, melody, and pressure.
candidates.notes_warnings: Known single still needs evidence role.

candidates.title: Frances Farmer Will Have Her Revenge on Seattle
